description: Triple-threshold Success Rate: fraction of docked molecules satisfying ALL three conditions — Vina kcal/mol < -8.0 AND SA score < 4 AND QED > 0.5 (TargetDiff Table 1 'Success' strict definition; TODO-22 metric #4).
source: computed from /mnt/disk1/Hugo_Lee/mol-metal/molmetal/data/mmp13_real/dock_results.csv (100 rows) for the Vina sub-criterion; SA/QED sub-criteria require RDKit which is not installed in this snapshot
notes: Triple-threshold success rate = 0/100 = 0.00 on 830c pocket. The CuAAC products have top-pose kcal/mol in [-1.82, -1.13]; the Vina sub-criterion (top_pose_kcal_mol < -8.0) is the binding constraint and none of the 100 products reach it.
